text_block_list.text: When I went to visit the injured <chrname>, there was a figure standing outside her room.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Let's do this, Togetogemi!
I'll patch up any injury in one quick poke!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I came to treat her, obviously!
A precious Umamusume is in a bind!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: If an acupuncturist doesn't stick needles, who will?!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I've even studied secret pressure points that work wonders on injuries!
Please, please, let me try them out~!

I want to do whatever I can for <chrname>.
...But leaving it entirely to her makes me anxious.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
You seem to be misunderstanding something.
You see... I'm not here to give you a treatment.

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
As the one and only acupuncturist...
I want to protect the future of Umamusume!
choice_data_list: You care that much about Umamusume...!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: "And if that leads to a future where they get completely crushed, that'd be the best..."

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
"Leave the rest to me.
No entry during the treatment...!"

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text: —Since I'm here, I might as well try out all sorts of things~☆

(CLANG! BANG! SCREEECH!)
(VROOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
This is incredible, simply incredible!
She's in even better shape than before her injury... How!?

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
I panicked pretty hard when I hit the wrong pressure point, though!
Wow, I'm a genius~☆
Just as she said, <chrname> powered up and made a full comeback!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
It was a total success!
I guess info on Umatter can actually be pretty useful...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, and while I was at it, I jabbed your pressure points
to boost your physical capabilities☆
Just as she said, <chrname> grew stronger and returned from her injury!

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, something just doesn't feel right~.
Like it's missing any real feedback...

text_block_list.name: Sasami Anshinzawa
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that happens sometimes!
I'll leave the rest to you~☆

Her injury's condition hadn't changed...
Let's just be thankful that <chrname> is safe.
